name: COR Valle La Pascua data center
notes: DCD reported the inaugurated Centro de Operaciones de Red in Valle La Pascua, Guarico includes a data center offering hosting, backup, database, virtual disk, server-backup, service-administration and storage services; project described as part of a national fiber expansion.

name: Banco de Venezuela alternate CPD Barquisimeto
notes: DCD reported Banco de Venezuela's alternate data-processing center in Barquisimeto, Lara was 70% advanced in 2013; a 2016 follow-up stated the institution had an alternate CPD in Barquisimeto synchronized with its main Caracas facility, but also questioned operational performance.

name: Cirion CAR1 Caracas Data Center
notes: Cirion's official page identifies CAR1 in Caracas as a carrier-neutral data center providing colocation, managed hosting and interconnection. Baxtel lists Cirion Caracas as Venezuela's operational carrier facility, but public power values vary across directory fields, so capacity is left null. Datacenters.com indexes Caracas/Miranda with Cirion Technologies Caracas 1.

name: Daycohost Centro Tecnologico Caracas
notes: Daycohost's own Data Centers page says it is Venezuela's multisite geo-distributed data center operator with two points of presence in Caracas and Valencia, Tier III certification, and more than 1,000 m2 of Caracas white space. Data Center Map lists the Caracas site at C. Londres, Caracas.

name: TOP Comunications Data Center
notes: Data Center Map lists TOP Comunications Data Center at Edificio Parque Cristal, Av. Francisco de Miranda, Caracas, and indicates it went operational in September 2025; directory snippets describe a 100 m2, 40-rack colocation facility.

name: Capa7 Web Services
notes: Data Center Map lists Capa7 Web Services at Lanex Building, C. Pascuale Giorgio Anex, 1st Floor, Caracas; Capa7 company profile describes hosting, VPS, cloud and dedicated-server services.

name: Grupo Lorini Data Center
notes: Directory sources list Grupo Lorini at Universidad Metropolitana, Caracas; ServerMO states Grupo Lorini operates one Tier II Uptime Institute data center providing cloud, IaaS, BaaS and backup-site services.
